description: Foundation layer: add connectivity_plus dependency, create design token system (app_tokens.dart), update app_colors.dart (add C.b900 + import tokens), create AppTheme.light + AppTheme.dark with AppTheme.theme alias, create ThemeService (shared_preferences persistence), create ScanCodeParser utility, create all shared widget components (BhOfflineBanner, BhSkeleton, BhStatusChip, BhPrimaryButton, BhStatTile, BhEmptyState, BhSectionHeader, BhAppBar, BhParcelCard), and write unit tests for ScanCodeParser. FEAT-002 depends on every file created here.
steps: 1. Edit pubspec.yaml — add `connectivity_plus: ^6.0.3` under dependencies (after shared_preferences line). Run `flutter pub get`.

2. Create lib/core/theme/app_tokens.dart — paste all const color tokens (kBrand50..kBrand900, kSurface*, kDark*, kBorder*, kText*, kDarkText*, kStatus*Bg/Fg, kDarkStatus*Bg/Fg, kOnline*, kOffline*, kDark*, kAction*), radius tokens (kRadiusSm=6, kRadiusMd=10, kRadiusLg=14, kRadiusXl=20, kRadiusFull=999), spacing tokens (kSpace2..kSpace48), and typography TextStyle consts (kDisplayLg..kMonoMd) as specified in the task brief. All TextStyles include `color: kTextPrimary`. kMonoMd includes `fontFamily: 'monospace'`.

3. Edit lib/core/theme/app_colors.dart — add `import 'app_tokens.dart';` at top. Add `static const Color b900 = Color(0xFF071920);` to class C (this fixes pre-existing missing-const bug referenced in field_card.dart InfoRow). Do NOT change any other existing constants.

4. Rewrite lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart — import app_tokens.dart and app_colors.dart. Define `static ThemeData get light` using token values per task spec (useMaterial3:true, scaffoldBg=kSurfaceRaised, colorScheme primary=kActionPrimary, inputDecoration radius=kRadiusMd focused=kBrand500, card color=kSurfaceBase elevation=0 border=kBorderDefault radius=kRadiusLg, elevatedButton radius=kRadiusLg minHeight=48, appBar bg=kSurfaceBase fg=kTextPrimary elevation=0 with bottom 1dp kBorderSubtle border, keep snackBar+divider themes). Define `static ThemeData get dark` using dark token values. Keep `static ThemeData get theme => light;` as backward-compat alias.

5. Create lib/core/services/theme_service.dart — `enum AppThemeMode { system, light, dark }`. `class ThemeService extends ChangeNotifier` with `AppThemeMode _mode = AppThemeMode.system`, getter `mode`, getter `flutterMode` (switch returning ThemeMode.system/light/dark), `Future<void> load()` reading SharedPreferences key 'theme_mode' and parsing enum name, `Future<void> setMode(AppThemeMode m)` persisting and calling notifyListeners().

6. Create lib/core/utils/scan_code_parser.dart — `class ScanCodeParser { static int? parse(String raw) }`. Logic: trim whitespace; if empty → null; if matches RegExp(r'^\d+$') → int.tryParse(trimmed); else → null. Add doc comment noting BH- prefix is reserved for future use (OD-01).

7. Create test/scan_code_parser_test.dart — import flutter_test and scan_code_parser.dart. Write group('ScanCodeParser', () { ... }) with 8 test cases: '1042'→1042, '  1042  '→1042, '0'→0, 'BH-1042'→null, '1042abc'→null, '+63912345678'→null, ''→null, '   '→null. Use expect(ScanCodeParser.parse(input), expected).

8. Create lib/widgets/bh_offline_banner.dart — `BhOfflineBanner({required Widget child})` StatefulWidget. initState: call `Connectivity().checkConnectivity()` to set initial `_isOffline`. Subscribe to `Connectivity().onConnectivityChanged` stream. When result is `ConnectivityResult.none` → _isOffline=true; else → false. Build: Column with AnimatedSlide(offset: _isOffline ? Offset.zero : Offset(0,-1), duration: 300ms, curve: Curves.easeInOut) wrapping a 36dp amber banner Container (Colors.amber.shade700 bg, white text '⚡ You're offline — data may be outdated', Semantics label set), followed by Expanded(child: child). Use `import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';`.

9. Create lib/widgets/bh_skeleton.dart — import app_tokens.dart. `SkeletonBox({double? width, double height=16, double radius=kRadiusMd})`: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(tween: Tween(begin:0, end:1), duration: Duration(milliseconds:1200), builder: animate a shimmer — use ColorTween(begin:kBrand50, end:kBrand100) and back with `curve: Curves.easeInOut`; draw a Container with BoxDecoration(color: lerpedColor, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius), width/height). Set repeat by chaining in didUpdateWidget or use AnimationController in a StatefulWidget instead — prefer StatefulWidget with AnimationController+repeat(reverse:true) for proper shimmer. `SkeletonCard({double height=80})`: full-width SkeletonBox(width:double.infinity, height:height, radius:kRadiusLg). `SkeletonList({int count=3, double itemHeight=80})`: Column with count SkeletonCards spaced kSpace8 apart.

10. Create lib/widgets/bh_status_chip.dart — `enum BhChipSize { small, normal }`. `BhStatusChip({required String status, BhChipSize size=BhChipSize.normal})`. Map: pending→(kStatusPendingBg, kStatusPendingFg, 'Pending'), ready_for_pickup→(kStatusPickupBg, kStatusPickupFg, 'Ready for Pickup'), out_for_delivery→(kStatusOnWayBg, kStatusOnWayFg, 'Out for Delivery'), delivered→(kStatusDeliveredBg, kStatusDeliveredFg, 'Delivered'), failed→(kStatusFailedBg, kStatusFailedFg, 'Failed'), cancelled→(kStatusCancelledBg, kStatusCancelledFg, 'Cancelled'), active→(kStatusDeliveredBg, kStatusDeliveredFg, 'Active'), inactive→(kStatusCancelledBg, kStatusCancelledFg, 'Inactive'), approved→(kStatusDeliveredBg, kStatusDeliveredFg, 'Approved'), suspended→(kStatusFailedBg, kStatusFailedFg, 'Suspended'), _→(kStatusCancelledBg, kStatusCancelledFg, status). Small: kLabelSm style, padding EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal:8, vertical:4). Normal: kLabelMd style, padding EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal:10, vertical:6). 8dp dot + SizedBox(width:5) + Text. Wrap in Semantics(label: 'Status: [label]').

11. Create lib/widgets/bh_primary_button.dart — `BhPrimaryButton({required String label, required VoidCallback? onPressed, bool loading=false, bool destructive=false, IconData? icon})`. SizedBox(width:double.infinity, child: ElevatedButton) with style: bg=(destructive?kActionDestructive:kActionPrimary), fg=white, minSize=Size(double.infinity,48), shape=RoundedRectangleBorder(kRadiusLg), elevation=0. Child: loading→Row(CircularProgressIndicator(20dp white)+SizedBox(8)+'Please wait'); else→Row(icon?+SizedBox(8)?+Text(label)). Semantics(label: label). Disabled when onPressed==null.

12. Create lib/widgets/bh_stat_tile.dart — `BhStatTile({required String value, required String label, IconData? icon, Color? iconColor, VoidCallback? onTap})`. Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(color:kSurfaceBase, border:Border.all(kBorderDefault), borderRadius:kRadiusLg), padding:EdgeInsets.all(kSpace16), child: GestureDetector(onTap:onTap, child: Column(crossAxisStart, [if icon: Icon(icon, size:20, color:iconColor??kBrand400), SizedBox(kSpace8), Text(value, style:kDisplayMd), Text(label, style:kBodySm.copyWith(color:kTextSecondary))]))). If onTap!=null, wrap in Semantics(button:true, minTouchTarget constraint to 48dp).

13. Create lib/widgets/bh_empty_state.dart — `BhEmptyState({required String title, String? subtitle, IconData icon=Icons.inbox_outlined, Widget? action})`. Center(child:Padding(32, Column(min, [Icon(icon,48dp,kTextMuted), SizedBox(16), Text(title,kHeadingSm style), if subtitle: SizedBox(8)+Text(subtitle,kBodyMd.copyWith(color:kTextSecondary)), if action: SizedBox(16)+action]))). Do NOT modify existing EmptyState.

14. Create lib/widgets/bh_section_header.dart — `BhSectionHeader({required String title, String? actionLabel, VoidCallback? onAction})`. Row(mainAxisAlignment:spaceBetween, [Text(title.toUpperCase(), style:kLabelLg.copyWith(color:kTextMuted)), if actionLabel!=null && onAction!=null: TextButton(onPressed:onAction, style:TextButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor:kActionPrimary, padding:EdgeInsets.zero), child:Text(actionLabel,style:kLabelMd))]).

15. Create lib/widgets/bh_app_bar.dart — `BhAppBar({required String title, bool showBack=false, List<Widget>? actions, PreferredSizeWidget? bottom}) implements PreferredSizeWidget`. preferredSize: Size.fromHeight(kToolbarHeight + (bottom?.preferredSize.height ?? 0)). build: AppBar(backgroundColor: brightness==dark?kDarkSurfaceBase:kSurfaceBase, foregroundColor: brightness==dark?kDarkTextPrimary:kTextPrimary, elevation:0, titleTextStyle: kHeadingMd.copyWith(color: brightness==dark?kDarkTextPrimary:kTextPrimary), shape: Border(bottom:BorderSide(color:kBorderSubtle,width:1)), leading: showBack&&canPop→IconButton(Icons.arrow_back), automaticallyImplyLeading:false, title:Text(title), actions:actions, bottom:bottom).

16. Create lib/widgets/bh_parcel_card.dart — `BhParcelCard({required Order order, required CourierProvider cp})`. Extracts the _ParcelCard logic from courier_orders_screen.dart exactly but uses token values: kBrand50, kBrand700, kBrand600, kBorderDefault, kTextPrimary, kTextSecondary, kTextMuted, kRadiusLg. Includes the same GestureDetector→Navigator.pushNamed('/courier/parcel', arguments:order.id), same action buttons (Details OutlinedButton + Picked Up/Delivered ElevatedButton), same _confirmAction dialog, same _PaymentBadge (inline or imported). Imports: Order from models/order.dart, CourierProvider, AppConstants, tokens, BhStatusChip (replaces StatusPill).
acceptance_criteria: flutter pub get exits 0 with connectivity_plus resolved
lib/core/theme/app_tokens.dart compiles with no errors — all token consts are accessible
C.b900 compiles in field_card.dart (pre-existing bug fixed)
AppTheme.light, AppTheme.dark, and AppTheme.theme (alias) all return valid ThemeData
ThemeService.load() reads 'theme_mode' from SharedPreferences; setMode() persists and notifies
flutter test test/scan_code_parser_test.dart passes all 8 test cases
BhOfflineBanner shows amber banner when connectivity is none, hides when restored
SkeletonList(count:3) renders 3 animated shimmer cards without errors
BhStatusChip(status:'delivered') renders a green chip with 'Delivered' label
BhPrimaryButton loading=true renders CircularProgressIndicator and 'Please wait'
BhAppBar renders back button only when showBack=true and Navigator.canPop()
BhParcelCard renders parcel card with Details button and optional action button
flutter analyze lib exits with 'No issues found!'
findings: Naming decisions: all token consts use k-prefix (kBrand50..kBrand900, kSurface*, kDark*, kBorder*, kText*, kDarkText*, kStatus*Bg/Fg, kDarkStatus*Bg/Fg, kOnline*, kOffline*, kAction*, radius/spacing/typography tokens). app_colors.dart already had C.b900 — only the import was added. app_theme.dart: unused import removed, const AppBarTheme applied. BhParcelCard uses ctx.read<CourierProvider>() for confirm action (avoids stale closure). BhOfflineBanner: connectivityChanged stream returns List<ConnectivityResult> in connectivity_plus ^6 — handled accordingly. Pre-existing issue: test/widget_test.dart and test/test/widget_test.dart both fail due to Provider<AuthProvider> not found in test harness — this is a pre-existing bug unrelated to FEAT-001 (confirmed: repo has no initial commit, failure exists in baseline). All FEAT-001 verification commands pass: flutter analyze returns No issues found; 8/8 scan_code_parser tests pass.
